name: Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn
take: Instant Response heavies gain +300% Crit DMG and vacuum enemies in while charging — the burst window learns gravity. Then the quality-of-life miracle: stand out of combat for 4s and she enters Instant Response: Brilliance, a PERMANENT Instant Response that lives outside the ult window (Charged II grants 100 Sync while it holds). And Sealed Trail: kills record the highest Trail stack count among the fallen and her next hit re-applies it. The first dawn never really sets.

name: Downy Notes of Snowfluff
take: Both halves of the Duet — Overture and Encore — get their DMG Multipliers DOUBLED. Rupture mode ramps the Duet's ticks +20% per repeat hit up to five deep; Fusion mode turns Stardust Resonance's bonus from 200% to 400%, upgrades each Fusion Trail stack to a 15% multiplier, and auto-detonates Fusion Burst on kills. The soft little name is a lie. This is the Duet node, and the Duet is the rotation.

name: Fervor Burns Bright as New
take: The Finale's DMG Multiplier is DOUBLED and Overdrive gets +40%. Her Instant Response heavies now inflict Tune Rupture - Shifting or Fusion Burst themselves — the burst window feeds its own debuff economy. And Between the Stars is rewritten: the full +60% Crit DMG and the 25% Finale amp arrive from the FIRST teammate proc instead of the three-stack ramp. Everything the base kit made you build toward, this copy just hands you at the door.

name: Ethereal Waltz on Binary Tides
take: The team node: casting her Intro, either Sync Strike, or the Seraphic Duet grants ALL Resonators +20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s. She swaps forms constantly — that's the kit — so in practice the waltz never stops and the whole team dances inside her buff. Binary tides, one tempo, everyone paid.

name: Voyage to the Astral Shore
take: Kills refill Starflux — the Mech flies free between fights. And the canon event: fatal damage turns her into a 2D Digital Ghost for 5s — yes, the digital girl literally drops a dimension — shielding the team for 360% of her ATK, then she revives at FULL Max HP with 30 Resonance Energy, once every 10 minutes. Other resonators cheat death. Aemeath respawns like the star of her own game, because she is.

name: A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You
take: Everything takes 40% more Resonance Liberation DMG from her — which is her entire damage profile, so read it as a flat 40%. Tune Rupture and Fusion Burst ticks can now CRIT at a fixed 80% rate and 275% Crit DMG. The circuit's Trail stamping is doubled, the team-wide Trail cap rises to a full 60 — and every Duet drops 10 stacks on the room. The journey ends where it was always headed: every number in the kit, arriving at once, to you.
